briefdescription.para: Match an 'ordered' floating point maximum function.

detaileddescription.para: Floating point has one special value 'NaN'. Therefore, there is no total order. However, if we can ignore the 'NaN' value (for example, because of a 'no-nans-float-math' flag) a combination of a fcmp and select has 'maximum' semantics. In the presence of 'NaN' we have to preserve the original select(fcmp(ogt/ge, L, R), L, R) semantics matched by this predicate. max(L, R) iff L and R are not NaN m_OrdFMax(L, R) = R iff L or R are NaN
